\caption{\textbf{Name-level correlation between probed warmth/competence and human ratings.} For each of the 282 rated applicant names, the model's residual-stream activation at the probe layer is projected onto the warmth and competence direction vectors. ``Probe layer'' gives the selected layer index and its resolved fraction of total depth (targeted $\mathrm{probe\_layer\_frac}=0.66$; the reported fraction is the integer-rounded layer divided by model depth).
